hero.label: Upwave
hero.title: Building a Platform That Makes Wellness Stick
hero.subtitle: I ran product and design for Turner's health and wellness venture, leading its internal designers and an external agency team from concept to 1M monthly users in eight months.

context.challenge: Pioneering health and wellness in the early IoT era.
context.scope: Product Leadership, Lean Methodology, Team Directorship
context.team: Internal product and design teams, engineering, and an external agency working alongside our designers
context.body: Upwave was Turner's IoT-driven digital health venture, exploring the intersection of quantified-self data and personalized content. As Vice President, Product & UX, I ran product and design, leading an internal eight-person UX, product, and design team and the external agency working alongside it. IDEO had served as the research partner during opportunity shaping and product positioning. A lean delivery model enabled daily releases and helped grow the venture to 1M monthly unique users in eight months.

sections.label: Market Validation & Delivery
sections.title: From validation to daily releases.
sections.description: Building a quantified-self platform before the Apple Watch required disciplined validation rather than a rush to build. I brought in IDEO to test the opportunity, shape the positioning, and challenge key assumptions before large-scale investment. The resulting lean product model established daily release cycles and increased platform recirculation from 5% to 24%.
